# Confirm dashboard counts stay accurate when opportunities are closed

## What & Why
The dashboard intentionally excludes closed opportunities from its active counts, but the current browser coverage does not verify that this remains true after status changes and reloads. A regression here could make the home summary disagree with the application queue.

## Done looks like
- A browser test creates an opportunity, changes it to Closed, and verifies the dashboard counts exclude it.
- The queue still shows the Closed status after reload.
- The test uses the existing persistence suite and stable application selectors.

## Relevant files
- artifacts/escape-hatch/src/App.tsx
- artifacts/escape-hatch/tests/persistence.spec.ts
